title: Graph Causal Optimal Transport and Wasserstein Distances
summary: We study the graph causal optimal transport problem, a generalisation of the classical optimal transport problem in which the allowed couplings satisfy causal restrictions prescribed by a directed graph. We characterise fully the directed acyclic graphs for which the associated graph causal Wasserstein discrepancy is a metric and show that the induced topology agrees with other natural adapted topologies.
